excerpts.text:
Home
>
Student Life
Campus Map
Campus with Tall Trees and Green Lawns
CUC is in Konodai, Ichikawa-shi, about a 20-minute train ride from Tokyo station. The campus has many facilities for students.
Main Building
The Main Building houses administrative offices handling student affairs on the lower three floors and the President’s office, conference rooms etc. on the upper floors. A multi-purpose conference room is located on the top floor. Students have free access to the computers in the campus l

other rooms to support student activities.
International Dormitory
International Dormitory is available for exchange students from CUC partner universities and International students of CUC.
Guest House
CUC has a Guest House New Annex, situated next to the campus, to accommodate researchers from overseas and visitors attending seminars held on campus. The Guest House New Annex has four single apartments, two family apartments, and a common room.

The Training Center is available for intensive training sessions for the university's athletic clubs, and as accommodation during training camps by other clubs as well as international exchange programs.
International Dormitory
International Dormitory is available for exchange students from CUC partner universities and International students of CUC.

广大师生：
因电力检修，将会对宝山校区部分楼宇的用电产生影响。望相关单位和广大师生做好停电准备，具体的停电时间和停电范围如下：

2026年6月16日(星期二)01:00-2026年6月16日(星期二) 03:00时间内Ⅰ段停电，切换至Ⅱ段恢复供电。
2026年6月17日(星期三)01:00-2026年6月17日(星期三) 03:00时间内全部停电，切换至Ⅰ段恢复供电。
2026年6月18日(星期四)01:00-2026年6月18日(星期四) 03:00时间内全部停电，切换原有恢复供电。

学生公寓：校内1号宿舍楼、校内2号宿舍楼、校内3号宿舍楼、校内4号宿舍楼、校内5号宿舍楼。
学院部处：智能网联汽车网络安全重点实验室(车队)、美院大楼、特种人形机器人研究院、体育中心教师办公室(绿保苗圃)、后勤大楼北侧体育中心办公室、鹿鸣堂、博观楼。
后勤保障部：后勤基建大楼、后勤辅助用房(零修班)、绿保苗圃、南大门门岗、南2门门岗、车队用房、南2门电动车充电桩、校内数字楼泵房。
